author: 3owj
content: Done (uncommitted): src/commands/sources_cmd.rs + 'csnotes sources tag PATTERN... -c COURSE [--replace|--remove] [--dry-run]'. Patterns: exact ID, folder prefix, or * glob (segment-local). Frontmatter edit is line-preserving and verified by re-parse; PDF/PPTX/DOCX are manifest-only (warned). Also fixed a parser bug found along the way: extract_source_meta deserialized the whole frontmatter into a struct, so 'status: "completed"' (16 SU sources) made courses/summary/tags silently vanish. Now field-wise. Verified on a vault copy: tags survive reconcile --reset.
